title: Hendtheer Darbar
desc: After losing his position in a government office, Shivaramu, a miserly man, is compelled to seek employment in a politician's liquor business to satisfy his wife's financial needs.

title: Sachein
desc: Sachein saves Shalini's father from a life-changing accident. However, pride keeps them from revealing their love, as their friendship faces challenges that test their hearts and egos.

title: Vikrant Rona
desc: When Vikrant Rona sets off to investigate a gruesome murder, a series of tragic deaths leads him to discover a supernatural connection. Subsequently, with varying clues, Vikrant must find the killer.

title: Dude
desc: Agan and Kural, lifelong friends, face a turning point when the latter suffers a heartbreak. Subsequently, Agan must decide whether to confess his secret love or keep his feelings hidden.

title: Mayura
desc: Mayura, a Brahmin boy, discovers his connections to the royal family. He then takes it upon himself to avenge the death of his father and works towards building his kingdom.
